subtests.name: An empty rule serializes with one space between its braces
The font-display descriptor serializes before feature value blocks
Block types serialize in a fixed order rather than source order
Empty blocks are omitted without changing the order of nonempty blocks
Distinct names retain source order rather than alphabetical order
A repeated name takes its last value without moving its first position
Merging separated blocks preserves first name positions across and within blocks
Invalid declarations neither reserve a name's position nor replace its value
Names are case-sensitive and escaped spellings update the same name in place
The historical-forms block serializes after the other block types
